criterion_1.claim: A non-file in-memory invocation path reaches the computational boundary.

criterion_2.claim: Kernel-facing interfaces on the admitted typed route contain no path, file-unit or parser semantics.

criterion_3.claim: Legacy file runs still reproduce reference results through adapters.
criterion_3.reason: The authoritative field-level composition from raw legacy Hupsel meteorology, crop, interception, irrigation, bottom, drainage and optional-process inputs into the process-ready typed application forcing is not yet established. A restricted DLL exchange mapping is insufficient and must not be generalized.

criterion_4.claim: Output serialization does not mutate physical state.

criterion_5.claim: Non-midnight or non-day requests are not rejected merely because a historical adapter used daily files.

nonclaims: M1 is not a broad or stable public API milestone.
Criterion 4 admission does not establish criterion 3.
No RossFast domain expansion is part of M1 closure.
No EB capability is part of this M1 campaign.
No legacy field-level scientific mapping may be invented merely to obtain PASS.
